title: Vehicle Insight — Buying a used car (15s vertical social ad)
background: Modern UK suburban driveway, late golden-hour light. A used dark-grey BMW X3 with a For Sale sign in the windscreen. Contemporary, realistic, cinematic colour grade with calm greys and a single brand-green accent (#33B87A).

characters.description: British woman, early 30s, casual smart jacket, holding her phone, cautious but confident body language
Middle-aged man, friendly but slightly evasive, stands by the car

scenes.camera: Slow push-in, shallow depth of field, eye level on the car
scenes.action: Buyer circles the car. Seller smiles. On-screen caption: "That 'clean' car you're about to buy…"
scenes.audio: Low tense ambient pad, distant street sounds (volume: low)

scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder close-up of the buyer's phone screen
scenes.action: She types the registration YH17 SRU into the Vehicle Insight plate field. A progress bar sweeps: 'Checking DVLA · DVSA · finance registers…'
scenes.audio: Soft UI ticks, rising synth note (volume: medium)

scenes.camera: Phone screen fills frame, three alert cards slam in one by one with subtle haptic-style shakes
scenes.action: Cards read: '£4,200 finance owed — ALERT', 'Mileage anomaly — ALERT', 'Cat S write-off — ALERT'. Cut to buyer's eyebrow raise; the seller's smile fades in soft-focus background.

dialogue.speaker: buyer
dialogue.line: Interesting… the report says there's finance still owed on it?

scenes.action: Vehicle Insight logo cascade (red, orange, teal speech-bubble swooshes), headline 'Know before you buy.', green CTA button 'Check any reg free →' with a soft double-bounce, 4.8-star rating, partner wordmarks: The Telegraph, What Car?, Halfords, Select Car Leasing, Asda.
scenes.audio: Resolving warm chord, gentle whoosh on logo (volume: medium). VO, female, warm and dry: "Know the full story behind any vehicle. Vehicle Insight."

style: Realistic with crisp motion-graphics overlays, brand fonts Fraunces (serif headlines) and Inter Tight (UI), 1080x1920 vertical, broadcast-clean
